image_description: A vertical, full-length shot of a bassoon standing upright on a stand in what appears to be a music studio or practice room. The instrument features a dark reddish-brown wooden body with silver metal keys and mechanisms. A curved metal bocal extends from the top joint, leading towards the upper right where a microphone stand is visible. The background includes a drum kit, amplifier, and soundproofing panels.
